note: Subject layer (layer 5) for the DINOSAUR faction, copied from the approved subject lines in docs/art/factions/DINOSAUR.md (bead pulp_wars-c87.7). Keys are runtime art subjects from src/assets/chibi-art-v7.ts: UNIT:DINOSAUR:<ROLE> for the eight land roles, UNIT:DINOSAUR:EGG for the one Egg sprite, PORTRAIT:DINOSAUR:<ROLE>, the command icons and CITY:DINOSAUR:<level>. Patrol Boat, Battleship, the embarked transport and the village reuse the Human art. The /PRIMAL keys are the fixed-colour look of batch direction-dinosaur (bead pulp_wars-3tq.13): every recipe of that batch is an edit, which sends only its instruction, so these lines document the look.

subjects.UNIT:DINOSAUR:FIGHTER: Subject: Caveman, a chunky cute friendly caveman with a huge round head about half of the figure's height and a tiny sturdy body: light peach skin, a big wild mane of charcoal black hair, a bushy charcoal black beard, thick eyebrows and a big goofy grin, a bright red headband, a big plain bright red fur tunic over one shoulder covering the chest, belly and legs down to the knees, a charcoal grey cord belt with one cream tooth, a huge chunky cream bone club with two round knobs raised in the right hand, bare peach arms and big bare peach feet; simple shapes and very few details; clearly a caveman with a giant bone, not a soldier.
subjects.UNIT:DINOSAUR:RAIDER: Subject: Raptor, a chunky cute lean running raptor dinosaur, wide and low, filling the whole width of the image: a big long-snouted head with big round friendly eyes and a toothy grin of small cream teeth, a slim body leaning forward on two strong hind legs, each foot with one big raised cream sickle claw, two small clawed arms tucked at the chest, and a long stiff tail held straight out behind; smooth dusty blue skin shaded darker navy blue, a few dark navy stripes on the tail and a pale cream belly and throat; a tall crest of bright red feathers from the top of the head down the back of the neck, and a big plain bright red blanket strapped over its back with a charcoal grey cord, hanging down both sides to the knees; simple shapes and very few details; the feet are the lowest thing in the image; clearly a fast two-legged runner, not a horse or a wolf.
subjects.UNIT:DINOSAUR:MARKSMAN: Subject: Spitter, a chunky cute small upright spitting dinosaur with a huge round head about half of the figure's height and a short sturdy body on two legs, the head and frill filling the whole width of the image: a wide round neck frill spread open like a fan all round the head, the frill plain flat bright red with a thin cream rim, dusty blue skin shaded darker navy blue with a pale cream belly, two small cream crests on top of the head, big round eyes, puffed cheeks and a pursed mouth spitting one small pale cream blob forward, small clawed arms, a plain bright red cloth poncho over the chest, belly and back down to the knees, a short tail, cream claws on the feet; simple shapes and very few details; clearly a frilled spitter, not an archer.
subjects.UNIT:DINOSAUR:GUARD: Subject: Ankylosaurus, a chunky cute armoured dinosaur, a low round dome on four short stubby legs, as tall as a soldier's shoulders and filling the whole width of the image: a big blunt head held low at the front with big round sleepy eyes, a small smile and two short cream cheek horns, a high round domed back of dusty blue bony plates shaded darker navy blue with a rim of chunky cream spikes all round its edge, a thick tail raised high behind it ending in a huge round cream bone club, a pale cream belly; a big plain bright red blanket lies over the middle of the dome between the spikes and hangs down both sides to the ground, tied with a charcoal grey cord; simple shapes and very few details; the feet are the lowest thing in the image; clearly a living armoured dome with a tail club, not a turtle and not a shield soldier.
subjects.UNIT:DINOSAUR:CAPTAIN: Subject: Shaman, a chunky cute old cave shaman with a huge round head about half of the figure's height and a tiny sturdy body: light peach skin, a bushy charcoal black beard and big friendly eyes, wearing the top half of a big cream long-snouted beast skull as a hood, its toothy upper jaw sticking forward over his brow like a cap peak, three tall bright red feathers standing up behind the skull, a long plain bright red robe from the shoulders down to the feet, a big round drum of pale cream rawhide on a dark basalt grey frame hanging at his belly, a chunky cream bone drumstick raised high in the right hand, a cream tooth necklace, bare peach feet; simple shapes and very few details; clearly a drummer in a beast-skull hood, not a skeleton and not a standard bearer.
subjects.UNIT:DINOSAUR:CATAPULT: Subject: Triceratops, a chunky cute stocky horned dinosaur on four thick legs, clearly bigger than a soldier, filling the whole width of the image: a huge head lowered to charge, about half of its whole length, with two long cream brow horns pointing forward, one short cream nose horn and a cream beak, small determined friendly eyes, and a big round bony neck frill standing up behind the head, the frill plain flat bright red with a rim of small cream studs; a heavy barrel body with dusty blue skin shaded darker navy blue and a pale cream belly, a short thick tail; a plain bright red blanket strapped over its back with a charcoal grey cord, hanging down both sides; simple shapes and very few details; the feet are the lowest thing in the image; clearly a charging three-horned beast, not a catapult and not a rhinoceros.
subjects.UNIT:DINOSAUR:KNIGHT: Subject: T-Rex, a chunky cute big tyrannosaur standing upright on two thick legs, clearly bigger than a soldier: an enormous boxy head about half of its whole height with huge open jaws, a row of big chunky cream teeth, big round friendly eyes and a goofy grin, two tiny arms with two claws each held at the chest, a fat body and a thick tail resting behind; dusty blue skin shaded darker navy blue with a pale cream lower jaw and belly; a wide plain bright red cloth collar round the neck, a big plain bright red blanket strapped over the back and hips with a charcoal grey cord, hanging down both sides to the knees, and two plain bright red cloth bands round the tail; big three-toed feet with cream claws; simple shapes and very few details; the feet are the lowest thing in the image; clearly a giant-jawed tyrant lizard with tiny arms, not a dragon and not a knight.
subjects.UNIT:DINOSAUR:JUGGERNAUT: Subject: Brontosaurus, a chunky cute giant long-necked dinosaur seen from the side, much wider and taller than a normal soldier: one huge round barrel body standing on four thick pillar legs, and one very long thick neck that rises straight up from the front of the body to the top of the image and ends in the animal's only head, a big round smooth head without horns, with big sleepy friendly eyes and a gentle smile; a long thick tail behind; clear cornflower blue skin shaded darker slate blue with a pale cream belly and throat; three broad plain bright red cloth bands round the neck and a huge plain bright red blanket draped over the whole back, hanging down both flanks to the knees and tied under the belly with a charcoal grey cord; simple shapes and very few details; the feet are the lowest thing in the image; clearly a gentle long-necked giant, not a dragon and not an elephant.
subjects.UNIT:DINOSAUR:EGG: Subject: one big chunky egg standing upright in a small round nest: a pale cream eggshell with a few big dusty blue speckles and one broad plain bright red painted band round its middle, sitting in a low nest ring of pale cream bones lined with a plain bright red cloth whose folds hang over the rim all round; nothing else in the image.
subjects.PORTRAIT:DINOSAUR:FIGHTER: Subject: Caveman portrait, head and shoulders of a chunky cute friendly caveman: a huge round head with light peach skin, a big wild mane of charcoal black hair, a bushy charcoal black beard and a big goofy grin, a bright red headband, a plain bright red fur tunic over one shoulder, and a huge chunky cream bone club raised beside the head.
subjects.PORTRAIT:DINOSAUR:RAIDER: Subject: Raptor portrait, head and neck of a chunky cute raptor dinosaur: a big long-snouted dusty blue head with a pale cream throat, big round friendly eyes and a toothy grin of small cream teeth, a tall crest of bright red feathers along the top of the head and neck, a plain bright red cloth collar at the base of the neck, and one big cream sickle claw raised beside the jaw; no rider.
subjects.PORTRAIT:DINOSAUR:MARKSMAN: Subject: Spitter portrait, head and neck of a chunky cute frilled spitting dinosaur: a round dusty blue head with two small cream crests, big round eyes, puffed cheeks and a pursed mouth, framed by a wide round neck frill spread open like a fan, the frill plain flat bright red with a thin cream rim, a pale cream throat.
subjects.PORTRAIT:DINOSAUR:GUARD: Subject: Ankylosaurus portrait, a chunky cute armoured dinosaur shown whole and small: a big blunt dusty blue head with sleepy eyes and two cream cheek horns, a round dome of dusty blue plates rimmed with chunky cream spikes, a plain bright red blanket over the middle of the dome, and a huge round cream tail club raised behind.
subjects.PORTRAIT:DINOSAUR:CAPTAIN: Subject: Shaman portrait, head and shoulders of a chunky cute old cave shaman: light peach skin, a bushy charcoal black beard and big friendly eyes under the top half of a big cream long-snouted beast skull worn as a hood, three tall bright red feathers behind it, plain bright red robe shoulders and a cream bone drumstick raised beside the head.
subjects.PORTRAIT:DINOSAUR:CATAPULT: Subject: Triceratops portrait, the head of a chunky cute horned dinosaur seen from the front-right: two long cream brow horns, one short cream nose horn, a cream beak and small friendly eyes on a dusty blue face, with a big round neck frill standing up behind it, the frill plain flat bright red with a rim of small cream studs.
subjects.PORTRAIT:DINOSAUR:KNIGHT: Subject: T-Rex portrait, the head of a chunky cute big tyrannosaur: an enormous boxy dusty blue head with huge open jaws, a row of big chunky cream teeth, a pale cream lower jaw, big round friendly eyes and a goofy grin, a wide plain bright red cloth collar round the neck and one tiny two-clawed arm waving below.
subjects.PORTRAIT:DINOSAUR:JUGGERNAUT: Subject: Brontosaurus portrait, the head and long neck of a chunky cute gentle long-necked dinosaur: a small round pale dusty blue head with big sleepy eyes and a gentle smile on top of a thick neck rising from the bottom of the image, a pale cream throat, and three broad plain bright red cloth bands round the neck.
subjects.ICON:ACTION:LAY_EGG: Subject: one big chunky pale cream egg with a few big dusty blue speckles, standing upright in a low round nest ring of pale cream bones; nothing else in the image.
subjects.ICON:ACTION:HATCH: Subject: one big chunky pale cream egg with dusty blue speckles splitting open along a bold black zigzag crack, the top of the shell lifting like a lid, a small round dusty blue baby snout with two big round eyes peeking out, and three small cream shell chips flying off; nothing else in the image.
subjects.ICON:ACTION:STAMPEDE: Subject: the lowered head of a charging horned beast seen from the side, facing right: two long cream brow horns and one short cream nose horn pointing right, a dusty blue face and a round dusty blue neck frill with a cream rim, and three round pale cream dust puffs trailing behind on the left; nothing else in the image.
subjects.ICON:ACTION:DINOSAUR:RALLY: Subject: one big round drum, a pale cream rawhide drumhead on a dark basalt grey frame lashed with charcoal grey cord, with two chunky cream bone drumsticks crossed above it and three short jagged pale cream beat lines bursting upward; nothing else in the image.
subjects.CITY:DINOSAUR:1: Subject: a small level-1 bone-and-hide camp: one tall totem pole of stacked cream bones topped with a small horned beast skull and a big plain bright red banner flag, and three chunky cone tents of plain flat solid bright red hide stretched over crossed cream tusks pressed around its foot, and one small dark basalt standing stone; wide and chunky, filling the whole width of the image. Buildings only.
subjects.CITY:DINOSAUR:2: Subject: a medium level-2 bone-and-hide camp, clearly bigger than a small camp, with no castle and no wall: five chunky cone tents of plain flat solid bright red hide over crossed cream tusks in two sizes, crowded together, one tall totem pole of stacked cream bones with a horned beast skull and a big plain bright red banner flag, two dark basalt standing stones, and a low fence of curved cream tusks along the front with an open gap; wide and chunky, filling the whole width of the image. Buildings only.
subjects.CITY:DINOSAUR:3: Subject: a large level-3 bone-and-hide camp, the biggest settlement, with no castle: one giant cream rib-cage arching high over the whole camp like a row of huge curved ribs, a huge horned cream beast skull over the open front gate, big plain flat solid bright red hide awnings stretched between the ribs, eight chunky cone tents of plain bright red hide in different sizes underneath, two tall bone totem poles with big plain bright red banner flags, and a ring of dark basalt standing stones; wide and chunky, filling the whole image. Buildings only.
subjects.UNIT:DINOSAUR:FIGHTER/PRIMAL: Subject: Caveman, a chunky cute friendly caveman with a huge round head and a tiny sturdy body: light golden tan skin, a wild mane of charcoal black hair and a bushy black beard, a deep ochre fur pelt over one shoulder with big bold solid dark brown spots and a dark brown trim, a bone-white headband, a necklace of big cream teeth, two short bright orange war paint stripes on each cheek and an orange band on the upper arm, a huge cream bone club raised in the right hand; no red and no player colour.
subjects.UNIT:DINOSAUR:RAIDER/PRIMAL: Subject: Raptor, a chunky cute lean running raptor: deep blue hide with a dark navy back, a cream belly, throat and claws, a tall crest of bright orange feathers, and bold bright orange tiger stripes, fat wedges from the spine, on the back and tail; no blanket, no red and no player colour.
subjects.UNIT:DINOSAUR:MARKSMAN/PRIMAL: Subject: Spitter, a chunky cute small upright frilled spitting dinosaur: deep blue hide with a cream belly, a wide round neck frill in dark navy with a thin bright orange rim and thick bright orange ray stripes like spokes, puffed cheeks spitting one pale blob; no poncho, no red and no player colour; the frill is never a solid orange disc.
subjects.UNIT:DINOSAUR:GUARD/PRIMAL: Subject: Ankylosaurus, a chunky cute armoured dinosaur, a low round dome on four stubby legs: a dome of dark navy bony plates in chunky bands with a rim of cream spikes, a deep blue head and legs, a cream belly, and a huge round bright orange tail club; no blanket, no red and no player colour.
subjects.UNIT:DINOSAUR:CAPTAIN/PRIMAL: Subject: Shaman, a chunky cute old cave shaman: light golden tan skin, a bushy black beard, the top half of a big cream long-snouted beast skull worn as a hood with three tall bright orange feathers behind it, a long deep ochre fur robe with big bold solid dark brown spots and a dark brown trim, a round rawhide drum at his belly, a cream bone drumstick raised, a cream tooth necklace and bright orange war paint; clearly the leader; no red and no player colour.
subjects.UNIT:DINOSAUR:CATAPULT/PRIMAL: Subject: Triceratops, a chunky cute stocky horned dinosaur on four thick legs with its head lowered to charge: deep blue hide with a few dark navy bands on the body and a cream belly, long cream horns and beak, and a big round neck frill in the same deep blue with a thick bright orange rim and two big solid bright orange eye-spots; no blanket, no red and no player colour; the frill is never a solid orange disc.
subjects.UNIT:DINOSAUR:KNIGHT/PRIMAL: Subject: T-Rex, a chunky cute big tyrannosaur standing upright: deep blue hide with a dark navy back, a cream lower jaw and belly, big cream teeth, a short crest of bright orange spikes over the brow and down the neck and back, and a few very thick bright orange tiger stripes on the back and tail; no cape, no scarf, no red and no player colour.
subjects.UNIT:DINOSAUR:JUGGERNAUT/PRIMAL: Subject: Brontosaurus, a chunky cute giant long-necked dinosaur seen from the side: deep blue hide with a dark navy back, a cream belly and throat, and big solid bright orange blotches along the back and down the back of the neck; no neck bands, no blanket, no red and no player colour.
subjects.UNIT:DINOSAUR:EGG/PRIMAL: Subject: one big chunky egg standing upright in a small round nest: a warm cream eggshell with a few big bold solid bright orange speckles and no painted band, in a low nest ring of pale cream bones and dry tan straw; no red, no cloth and no player colour.
subjects.PORTRAIT:DINOSAUR:FIGHTER/PRIMAL: Subject: Caveman portrait, head and shoulders: light golden tan skin, a wild black mane and beard, a bone-white headband, bright orange war paint on the cheeks, a deep ochre fur pelt with bold dark brown spots over one shoulder, a tooth necklace and the cream bone club beside the head; no red.
subjects.PORTRAIT:DINOSAUR:RAIDER/PRIMAL: Subject: Raptor portrait, head and neck: a deep blue long-snouted head with a cream throat and small cream teeth, a tall crest of bright orange feathers and two or three bright orange stripes on the neck; no collar and no red.
subjects.PORTRAIT:DINOSAUR:MARKSMAN/PRIMAL: Subject: Spitter portrait, head and neck: a round deep blue head with puffed cheeks, framed by a wide dark navy neck frill with a bright orange rim and thick bright orange ray stripes; a cream throat; no red.
subjects.PORTRAIT:DINOSAUR:GUARD/PRIMAL: Subject: Ankylosaurus portrait, shown whole and small: a deep blue head, a dome of dark navy plates rimmed with cream spikes and a huge round bright orange tail club; no blanket and no red.
subjects.PORTRAIT:DINOSAUR:CAPTAIN/PRIMAL: Subject: Shaman portrait, head and shoulders: light golden tan skin and a black beard under a cream beast-skull hood with bright orange feathers behind it, deep ochre spotted fur shoulders and a cream bone drumstick; no red.
subjects.PORTRAIT:DINOSAUR:CATAPULT/PRIMAL: Subject: Triceratops portrait, the head from the front-right: cream horns and beak on a deep blue face, with a big round deep blue neck frill with a thick bright orange rim and cream studs; no red.
subjects.PORTRAIT:DINOSAUR:KNIGHT/PRIMAL: Subject: T-Rex portrait, the head: an enormous boxy deep blue head with huge open jaws, big cream teeth and a cream lower jaw, a crest of bright orange spikes over the brow and neck; no collar and no red.
subjects.PORTRAIT:DINOSAUR:JUGGERNAUT/PRIMAL: Subject: Brontosaurus portrait, the head and long neck: a small round deep blue head with sleepy eyes on a thick neck with a cream throat and a few big solid bright orange blotches down the back of the neck; no neck bands and no red.
subjects.CITY:DINOSAUR:1/PRIMAL: Subject: a small level-1 bone-and-hide camp: three chunky cone tents of tawny spotted hide over crossed cream tusks, one tall totem pole of stacked cream bones with a small horned skull and a bare pole beside it for a pennant, a few bright orange feathers; no red and no banner cloth. Buildings only.
subjects.CITY:DINOSAUR:2/PRIMAL: Subject: a medium level-2 bone-and-hide camp: five cone tents of tawny spotted hide in two sizes, a bone totem pole with a horned skull, a bare pole for a pennant, dark basalt standing stones and a low tusk fence, with a few bright orange feathers and painted marks; no red and no banner cloth. Buildings only.
subjects.CITY:DINOSAUR:3/PRIMAL: Subject: a large level-3 bone-and-hide camp under one giant cream rib-cage with a huge horned skull over the gate: tawny hide awnings and tents with dark brown spots, bone totems, a bare pole for a pennant, basalt standing stones, and a few bright orange feathers and painted marks; no red and no banner cloth. Buildings only.
subjects.ICON:ACTION:LAY_EGG/PRIMAL: Subject: one big chunky warm cream egg with a few big bold solid bright orange speckles, standing upright in a low round nest ring of pale cream bones; nothing else in the image.
subjects.ICON:ACTION:HATCH/PRIMAL: Subject: one big chunky warm cream egg with bright orange speckles splitting open along a bold black zigzag crack, the top of the shell lifting like a lid, a small round deep blue baby snout with two big round eyes peeking out, and three small cream shell chips flying off; nothing else in the image.
subjects.ICON:ACTION:STAMPEDE/PRIMAL: Subject: the lowered head of a charging horned beast seen from the side, facing right: two long cream brow horns and one short cream nose horn, a deep blue face and a round deep blue neck frill with a thick bright orange rim, and three round pale cream dust puffs trailing behind on the left; nothing else in the image.
subjects.UNIT:DINOSAUR:PATROL_BOAT: Subject: Patrol Boat of the Dinosaur tribe, a chunky cute small stone-age dugout canoe seen from the front-right: one big hollowed log of warm tawny wood with dark brown bark, the bow carved into a long-necked plesiosaur head painted deep blue with bold red-orange stripes and a cream jaw, one bone-white mast with one big sail of dull sandy brown animal hide with big dark brown spots, and three red-orange feathers on top; simple shapes and very few details; cheerful, never scary.
subjects.UNIT:DINOSAUR:BATTLESHIP: Subject: Battleship of the Dinosaur tribe, a chunky cute big stone-age war raft seen from the front-right: a deep hull of big tied logs of warm tawny wood with cream bone fittings, the bow carved into a big plesiosaur head painted deep blue with bold red-orange stripes and a cream jaw, a hide-covered lookout hut, two bone-white masts with big sails of dull sandy brown hide with big dark brown spots, and red-orange feathers on top; simple shapes and very few details.
subjects.UNIT:DINOSAUR:EMBARKED_TRANSPORT: Subject: Embarked transport of the Dinosaur tribe, a chunky cute wide low log raft seen from the front-right, no mast and no sail: logs of warm tawny wood tied with rope, a small carved deep blue plesiosaur head with red-orange stripes at the front, two wooden paddles, a heap of cargo under dull sandy brown hide with big dark brown spots, and a bone pole with three red-orange feathers; simple shapes and very few details.
subjects.PORTRAIT:DINOSAUR:PATROL_BOAT: Subject: Patrol Boat of the Dinosaur tribe, a chunky cute small dugout canoe shown whole from the front-right: a tawny log hull, a deep blue plesiosaur-head prow with bold red-orange stripes, one big sandy brown hide sail with big dark brown spots; no water; simple shapes and very few details.
subjects.PORTRAIT:DINOSAUR:BATTLESHIP: Subject: Battleship of the Dinosaur tribe, a chunky cute big log war raft shown whole from the front-right: tawny logs with cream bone fittings, a big deep blue plesiosaur-head prow with bold red-orange stripes, two sandy brown hide sails with big dark brown spots; no water; simple shapes and very few details.
subjects.IMPROVEMENT:DINOSAUR:WINDMILL: Subject: a stone-age grinding mill: one huge round flat grey millstone with a hole in its centre resting flat on three squat dark basalt stones, a thick rough wooden pole through its hole as a lever, and a small lean-to shelter of tawny hide stretched over curved pale bone poles behind it, with a woven basket of grain beside the stone; wide and low; no metal anywhere. Buildings only.
subjects.IMPROVEMENT:DINOSAUR:SAWMILL: Subject: a stone-age wood chopping camp: one huge stone axe with a grey flint head lashed to a thick wooden handle, stuck upright in a wide tree stump, as tall as the image and the biggest thing in it; beside it a neat pile of pale split logs showing their round pale ends, and behind it a small lean-to of tawny hide on pale bone poles; wide and low; no metal and no saw blade anywhere. Buildings only.
subjects.UNIT:DINOSAUR:SUBMARINE: Subject: Submarine of the Dinosaur tribe, a chunky cute small stone-age log submersible seen from the front-right, long and low with no mast and no sail: one big closed hollow log of warm tawny wood with dark brown bark, carved into the shape of a plesiosaur, the bow a short carved neck and head painted deep blue with bold red-orange stripes and a cream jaw, two short carved wooden flippers on its side, a hatch on its back covered with dull sandy brown animal hide with big dark brown spots, and a bone-white breathing reed standing up from the hatch; a carved wooden boat, not a living animal; simple shapes and very few details.
subjects.PORTRAIT:DINOSAUR:SUBMARINE: Subject: Submarine of the Dinosaur tribe, a chunky cute small stone-age log submersible shown whole from the front-right: a closed tawny log hull carved like a plesiosaur, a deep blue carved head with bold red-orange stripes at the bow, two carved wooden flippers, a hatch covered with sandy brown hide with big dark brown spots, a bone-white breathing reed; no mast, no sail, no water; simple shapes and very few details.
